title: Distributor Re-Validation Charges by Lapse Period on Network and Server Quotes
content:
The re-issue charge on a re-issued Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote that lapsed unsigned follows the calendar days from the last day of the quote's validity period, the quote date plus the order type's quote validity days, to the re-issue day:

- for more than **30** days the distributor requalifies the units, and the charge is **60.00 USD** for each unit;
- for more than **7** and at most 30 days the distributor re-validates its price, and the charge is **1.5 percent** of the units times the distributor unit cost;
- for at most 7 days there is no re-issue charge.

The quote date and the distributor unit cost are those on the quote's own record; the validity days are the order type's (14 for a Network Equipment Order, 10 for a Server & Storage Build Order).

| Days after the last day of validity | Distributor action | Re-issue charge |
|---|---|---|
| 7 or fewer | none | nothing |
| 8 to 30 | price re-validated | 1.5 percent of the units times the distributor unit cost |
| 31 or more | units requalified | 60.00 for each unit |

### Worked cases (hypothetical Network Equipment Order quote of 4 units at a distributor unit cost of 2000.00, 14-day validity)

The last day of validity is day 14 after the quote date.

| Re-issued on | Days after the last day | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| day 21 after the quote date | 7 | nothing |
| day 22 | 8 | 1.5 percent of 8000.00, that is 120.00 |
| day 44 | 30 | 120.00 |
| day 45 | 31 | 4 times 60.00, that is 240.00 |
